Senate Standing Committees on Environment and Communications 

The Environment and Communications Committees cover the following portfolios: Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water, and Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts (Communications, Sport and the Arts functions only).

Telecommunications Legislation Amendment (Universal Outdoor Mobile Obligation) Bill 2025
Environment Protection Reform Bill 2025 and six related bills
Triple Zero service outage
Greenwashing
National Cultural Policy
